dedupe_keys.name: scdisrupt synth v1 0 a multi source synthetic benchmark dataset for supply chain disruption early warning research

description: Abhilash Deori publishes SCDisrupt-Synth, a synthetic benchmark for early warning of supply-chain disruptions. The August 2026 CSV contains 2,400 text-source records arranged into 600 prediction windows, each combining invented news, social media, supplier messages and financial reports. Scenarios cover several industries and regions and include both disruptions and non-disruptions. Download is free under CC BY 4.0. The benchmark can test information-processing components of supply-chain simulation experiments, including whether combined signals identify a staged disruption. It contains no real company communications and cannot calibrate empirical disruption probabilities or validate operational forecasts. Generation rules, class balance and transferability remain uncertain from the public summary. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this benchmark. The CSV was not downloaded, and model performance was not evaluated.
